adcp_recorder.parsers

NMEA message parsers for ADCP recorder.

This package contains parsers for all NMEA message types produced by Nortek ADCP instruments.

 64@dataclass(frozen=True)
 65class PNORI:
 66    """PNORI configuration message parser.
 67
 68    Format: $PNORI,InstrType,HeadID,BeamCnt,CellCnt,BlankDist,CellSize,CoordSys*CS
 69
 70    Positional fields with numeric coordinate system (0=ENU, 1=XYZ, 2=BEAM).
 71
 72    Example:
 73        >>> sentence = "$PNORI,4,Signature1000900001,4,20,0.20,1.00,0*2E"
 74        >>> config = PNORI.from_nmea(sentence)
 75        >>> config.instrument_type
 76        <InstrumentType.SIGNATURE: 4>
 77        >>> config.beam_count
 78        4
 79
 80    """
 81
 82    instrument_type: InstrumentType
 83    head_id: str
 84    beam_count: int | None
 85    cell_count: int | None
 86    blanking_distance: float | None
 87    cell_size: float | None
 88    coordinate_system: CoordinateSystem
 89    checksum: str | None = field(default=None, repr=False)
 90
 91    HEAD_ID_PATTERN: ClassVar[re.Pattern] = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,30}$")
 92
 93    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
 94        """Validate all fields after initialization."""
 95        _validate_head_id(self.head_id, 30)
 96        if self.beam_count is not None:
 97            _validate_beam_count(self.instrument_type, self.beam_count)
 98        if self.cell_count is not None:
 99            _validate_cell_count(self.cell_count)
100        _validate_distance(self.blanking_distance, "Blanking distance")
101        _validate_distance(self.cell_size, "Cell size")
102
103    @classmethod
104    def from_nmea(cls, sentence: str) -> "PNORI":
105        """Parse PNORI message from NMEA sentence.
106
107        Args:
108            sentence: NMEA sentence string (with or without checksum)
109
110        Returns:
111            Parsed PNORI configuration object
112
113        Raises:
114            ValueError: If sentence format is invalid or fields fail validation
115
116        """
117        fields, checksum = parse_nmea_sentence(sentence)
118        if len(fields) != 8:
119            raise ValueError(f"Expected 8 fields, got {len(fields)}")
120        if fields[0] != "$PNORI":
121            raise ValueError(f"Invalid prefix: expected $PNORI, got {fields[0]}")
122
123        # Parse and validate
124        return cls(
125            instrument_type=InstrumentType.from_code(int(fields[1])),
126            head_id=fields[2],
127            beam_count=int(fields[3]) if fields[3] and fields[3].lower() != "nan" else None,
128            cell_count=int(fields[4]) if fields[4] and fields[4].lower() != "nan" else None,
129            blanking_distance=parse_optional_float(fields[5]),
130            cell_size=parse_optional_float(fields[6]),
131            coordinate_system=CoordinateSystem.from_code(int(fields[7])),
132            checksum=checksum,
133        )
134
135    def to_nmea(self, include_checksum: bool = True) -> str:
136        """Serialize to NMEA sentence format.
137
138        Args:
139            include_checksum: If True, compute and append checksum
140
141        Returns:
142            NMEA sentence string
143
144        """
145        sentence = (
146            f"$PNORI,{self.instrument_type.value},{self.head_id},"
147            f"{self.beam_count},{self.cell_count},"
148            f"{self.blanking_distance:.2f},{self.cell_size:.2f},"
149            f"{self.coordinate_system.to_numeric_code()}"
150        )
151
152        if include_checksum:
153            checksum = compute_checksum(sentence)
154            sentence = f"{sentence}*{checksum}"
155
156        return sentence
157
158    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
159        """Convert to dictionary for database insertion.
160
161        Returns:
162            Dictionary with all fields mapped to database column names
163
164        """
165        return {
166            "sentence_type": "PNORI",
167            "instrument_type_name": self.instrument_type.name,
168            "instrument_type_code": self.instrument_type.value,
169            "head_id": self.head_id,
170            "beam_count": self.beam_count,
171            "cell_count": self.cell_count,
172            "blanking_distance": float(self.blanking_distance)
173            if self.blanking_distance is not None
174            else None,
175            "cell_size": float(self.cell_size) if self.cell_size is not None else None,
176            "coord_system_name": self.coordinate_system.value,
177            "coord_system_code": self.coordinate_system.to_numeric_code(),
178            "checksum": self.checksum,
179        }

Format: $PNORI,InstrType,HeadID,BeamCnt,CellCnt,BlankDist,CellSize,CoordSys*CS

Example:

sentence = "$PNORI,4,Signature1000900001,4,20,0.20,1.00,0*2E" config = PNORI.from_nmea(sentence) config.instrument_type config.beam_count 4

296class PNORITag:
297    """Tag definitions for PNORI2 format."""
298
299    INSTRUMENT_TYPE = "IT"
300    SERIAL_NUMBER = "SN"
301    NUM_BEAMS = "NB"
302    NUM_CELLS = "NC"
303    BLANKING_DISTANCE = "BD"
304    CELL_SIZE = "CS"
305    COORDINATE_SYSTEM = "CY"
306
307    VALID_TAGS = {
308        INSTRUMENT_TYPE,
309        SERIAL_NUMBER,
310        NUM_BEAMS,
311        NUM_CELLS,
312        BLANKING_DISTANCE,
313        CELL_SIZE,
314        COORDINATE_SYSTEM,
315    }
316
317    @classmethod
318    def parse_tagged_field(cls, field_str: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
319        """Parse a TAG=VALUE field.
320
321        Args:
322            field_str: Tagged field string (e.g., "IT=4")
323
324        Returns:
325            Tuple of (tag, value)
326
327        Raises:
328            ValueError: If field format is invalid
329
330        """
331        if "=" not in field_str:
332            raise ValueError(f"Tagged field must contain '=': {field_str}")
333
334        tag, value = field_str.split("=", 1)
335        return tag.strip().upper(), value.strip()

16class PNORE:
17    """PNORE wave energy density spectrum message (DF=501).
18    Format: $PNORE,Date,Time,Basis,Start,Step,Num,E1,E2,...,EN*CS
19    """
20
21    date: str
22    time: str
23    spectrum_basis: int | None
24    start_frequency: float | None
25    step_frequency: float | None
26    num_frequencies: int | None
27    energy_densities: list[float | None]
28    checksum: str | None = field(default=None, repr=False)
29
30    def __post_init__(self):
31        validate_date_yy_mm_dd(self.date)
32        validate_time_string(self.time)
33        if self.spectrum_basis is not None:
34            if self.spectrum_basis not in {0, 1, 3}:
35                raise ValueError(f"Invalid spectrum basis: {self.spectrum_basis}")
36        if self.start_frequency is not None:
37            validate_range(self.start_frequency, "Start frequency", 0.0, 10.0)
38        if self.step_frequency is not None:
39            validate_range(self.step_frequency, "Step frequency", 0.0, 10.0)
40        if self.num_frequencies is not None:
41            validate_range(self.num_frequencies, "Number of frequencies", 1, 999)
42
43        if self.num_frequencies is not None:
44            if len(self.energy_densities) != self.num_frequencies:
45                raise ValueError(
46                    f"Missing energy density values: expected {self.num_frequencies}, "
47                    f"got {len(self.energy_densities)}"
48                )
49
50    @classmethod
51    def from_nmea(cls, sentence: str) -> "PNORE":
52        fields, checksum = parse_nmea_sentence(sentence)
53        if fields[0] != "$PNORE":
54            raise ValueError(f"Invalid prefix: {fields[0]}")
55
56        # Check for DF=101 or DF=100
57        # Wait, PNORE only implements DF=101/100 as energy density
58        # For DF=101, it includes spectral basis
59
60        # Determine format based on number of fields
61        # DF=100: $PNORE,YYMMDD,HHMMSS,E1,E2,...
62        # DF=101: $PNORE,YYMMDD,HHMMSS,SpectrumBasis,StartFreq,StepFreq,NumFreq,E1,E2,...
63
64        # Actually our implementation expects the DF=101 format:
65        # fields: YYMMDD, HHMMSS, Basis, Start, Step, Num
66        if len(fields) < 7:
67            raise ValueError(f"Expected at least 7 fields for PNORE, got {len(fields)}")
68
69        num_freq = int(fields[6]) if fields[6] and fields[6].lower() != "nan" else 0
70
71        # Energy densities start from index 7
72        energies = [parse_optional_float(fields[i]) for i in range(7, len(fields))]
73
74        return cls(
75            date=fields[1],
76            time=fields[2],
77            spectrum_basis=int(fields[3]) if fields[3] and fields[3].lower() != "nan" else None,
78            start_frequency=parse_optional_float(fields[4]),
79            step_frequency=parse_optional_float(fields[5]),
80            num_frequencies=num_freq if num_freq > 0 else None,
81            energy_densities=energies,
82            checksum=checksum,
83        )
84
85    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
86        return {
87            "sentence_type": "PNORE",
88            "date": self.date,
89            "time": self.time,
90            "spectrum_basis": self.spectrum_basis,
91            "start_frequency": self.start_frequency,
92            "step_frequency": self.step_frequency,
93            "num_frequencies": self.num_frequencies,
94            "energy_densities": self.energy_densities,
95            "checksum": self.checksum,
96        }
